$comment: Evidence for Sprint 5 T4 (PLZG-233). One row per governed document: every claim it makes about repository, CI, GitHub or board state was checked against the system that owns that state, on 2026-10-06, and what was wrong was fixed in the same change. contradiction: false means the document makes no unlabelled claim that an owning system contradicts. It does NOT mean nothing is in dispute: a figure the document itself marks as disputed is listed in open_conflicts by its section in specs/meta/spec-drivers-v0.2.5.md, and scripts/sprint_5_gate.py t4 fails the row unless the register still holds that section OPEN, fails a row that omits an OPEN section its document cites, and names every carried conflict in its output. `note` says what was fixed, what was deliberately left, and what could not be checked. reviewed_blob is `git hash-object` of the file as reviewed; the gate recomputes it, so an edit after review invalidates the row. scripts/sprint_5_crosscheck_rehash.py lists the rows that have gone stale and re-stamps them only with --write.
